name: Chiffon Blouses
headline:
A lighter touch.
A little movement.
description: Soft layers, expressive prints and easy drape. Find a chiffon blouse for whatever the day has planned.
advice: Balance a flowing blouse with a more defined waist. Try a half-tuck with straight-leg trousers, or a simple camisole beneath a sheer style.

name: Cotton Blouses
headline:
Everyday ease.
Always you.
description: From a crisp collar to a relaxed sleeve. Start with a cotton blouse and make the rest your own.
advice: A relaxed shirt works with tailored trousers or your favourite jeans. Roll the cuffs, leave the collar open and add a simple belt for definition.

name: Denim Blouses
headline:
A familiar favourite.
A fresh feeling.
description: Washed blues, easy layers and a little everyday character. A new way to think about your denim days.
advice: Contrast a denim blouse with cream trousers, or try two different washes for a denim-on-denim outfit. Keep accessories simple and let the texture lead.
note: Our denim edit is coming together. In the meantime, explore these cotton alternatives from WOW Fashion.

name: Dressy Blouses
headline:
Plans worth
dressing up for.
description: An interesting sleeve. A considered neckline. Discover the details that make an ordinary evening feel a little more special.
advice: Pair a statement sleeve or dramatic neckline with a clean trouser shape. A small bag and understated jewellery keep the blouse at the centre of the outfit.

name: Lace Blouses
headline:
All in
the detail.
description: Delicate patterns and a softer mood. Explore lace blouses, from a subtle trim to a statement sleeve.
advice: Try intricate lace with simple denim or a softly tailored trouser. Check the product photographs for sheer panels and choose an underlayer that works for you.

name: Long Sleeved Blouses
headline:
A little coverage.
A lot of possibility.
description: Relaxed cuffs, beautiful sleeves and versatile shapes. Find the long-sleeved blouse that fits your day.
advice: A full sleeve pairs well with a straight or tapered bottom. For layering, choose a jacket with enough room through the arm so the fabric can sit comfortably.

name: Peasant Blouses
headline:
An unhurried day.
Your kind of ease.
description: Loose shapes, romantic sleeves and relaxed necklines. Discover a softer approach to getting dressed.
advice: Wear a loose blouse with straight-leg denim or a fitted skirt. Try a small front tuck to define the waist without losing the relaxed silhouette.
assignment: Editorial selection based on relaxed shape, full sleeves and gathered or open neckline; not an existing shop taxonomy.

name: Pussy Bow Blouses
headline:
Tie it
your way.
description: A softly tied neckline changes the whole feeling. Explore bow and tie-neck blouses for workdays and after-hours plans.
advice: Tie a loose bow for a softer finish, or leave the ties hanging beneath a blazer. Keep necklaces minimal so the neckline has room to make its statement.
assignment: Editorial bow and tie-neck selection. The live Pussy Bow shop category has no assigned products.

name: Ruffled Blouses
headline:
A little flourish.
A different mood.
description: Playful edges, sculpted sleeves and soft movement. Find a ruffled blouse with just the right amount of extra.
advice: Choose one statement area: neckline, cuff or shoulder. Wear fuller ruffles with a clean skirt or straight trouser to let the shape stand out.

name: Satin Blouses
headline:
Catch the light.
Keep it effortless.
description: A subtle sheen and a soft silhouette. Explore satin blouses for dinner plans, desk days and everything between.
advice: Pair a satin finish with matte tailoring or relaxed denim. A small front tuck gives shape while preserving the drape. Check the product details for fibre content.

name: Short Sleeved Blouses
headline:
Less sleeve.
More possibility.
description: For lighter layers and easy mornings. Discover short-sleeved blouses, from simple shapes to standout details.
advice: Try a shorter sleeve with a high-waisted trouser or flowing skirt. Add a light jacket when you need another layer, keeping the neckline visible.

name: Silk Blouses
headline:
Softly spoken.
Beautifully worn.
description: Fluid shapes and delicate details. Explore the silk blouse edit and find a piece to make your own.
style: Let the drape do the work
advice: A fluid blouse works beautifully against tailored shapes. Check each listing for its exact fibre composition and follow the care label for that garment.

name: Summer Blouses
headline:
A little sunshine.
A lighter wardrobe.
description: Open necklines, relaxed fits and a warm-weather mood. Find a summer blouse for slow days and spontaneous plans.
advice: Try a relaxed blouse with easy shorts, linen-look trousers or a simple skirt. Check fabric composition and opacity to choose the layer that suits your plans.

name: Work and Formal Blouses
headline:
Your day.
Beautifully composed.
description: Considered collars and thoughtful details. Discover blouses for the working week and the plans that follow.
advice: Start with tailored trousers and a blouse that sits comfortably at the shoulder. Add a blazer for structure, or keep the collar and cuffs as your only accents.
